title: Cosmic Cauldron Vision
description: A glowing purple and red cauldron emits a large spherical bubble containing a luminous red bird-like creature with multiple eyes, surrounded by floating orbs, stars, and cosmic patterns. A large purple spider with glowing eyes hovers above the bubble while a silhouetted antlered figure holding a red lantern walks along a winding path toward the cauldron.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a large ornate black cauldron glowing with purple runes, emitting a massive transparent sphere filled with a glowing red multi-eyed bird creature, cosmic nebulae, floating blue orbs and stars. A giant purple spider with glowing eyes sits atop the sphere. In the foreground, a silhouetted antlered figure carries a red lantern along a glowing winding path. Scattered butterflies, flowers, and floating papers fill the dark background with purple and teal accents.
